additional_info.subject: 0414888 - ID0414542-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / SD 170004222] Charging issue[C1] CRM:00314000155
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon,
I am reaching out from the Expert Services team in regards of child ticket
ID041488.
The ticket was opened for charging session transactionId:41769429 on charger
9NamV1
, which started on 2025-02-07T11:58:58 and received the StopTransaction on 2025-02-10T08:22:30.
The charging itself stopped on 2025-02-07T12:46:36, but the OCPP Stop Transaction command was sent only on 2025-02-10, after a reboot of the charger was triggered.
This behavior was due to an error on the SECC. The SECC had an issue in parsing a configuration file, which resulted into the EcoG unable to confirm the status of the outlet, hence to communicate to the OCPP Backend the information required (in this case, the end of the session on DC2).
This issue can be seen in the logs, which are getting corrupted by a very high logging, as follows:
The issue has already been reported to R&D, who is aware of the problem and in discussion with EcoG to develop a solution. I will inform you on the resolution progresses as soon as I will receive feedback from R&D.
I had an overview of the charger on AWS, and I noticed that a similar behavior happened only two other times, on 2025-02-17/18 and on 2025-03-03.
Since it is proven that a reboot of the charger can solve the issue, I would suggest to set an automatic reboot of the charger every two days, until a solution from R&D is provided.
If you agree, I will align with the colleagues of RC-FR and set this automatic reboot for you.
Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon!
With kind regards,

additional_info.subject: RE: 0414888 - ID0414542-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / SD 170004222] Charging issue[C1] CRM:00314000155
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Mr. Mi-poudou,
Apologies for the late reply. In eMobility, SECC refers to “Supply Equipment Communication/Charge Controller”. Therefore the SECC is the EcoG controller in the charger responsible for the communication with the EVCC (Electric Vehicle Communication/Charge Controller) inside all EVs.
Thank you for the information regarding the automatic reboot already set for the charger. At the moment we do not have another solution to overcome the issue, which is anyway appearing not often. I will keep monitoring the charger while pushing our R&D department and EcoG for a fast resolution. In case in the future the issue will appear on a daily basis, it might be worth considering a replacement of the EcoG controller.
I will keep you updated regarding developments on a resolution path.
With kind regards,

I will proceed to close this ticket. In case you observe similar issue, please report to us by opening a new ticket.
